data.name: Son Goku
data.description:
The second son of the low-class Bardock and Gine on Planet Vegeta, Kakarot was a member of the human-like alien race of warriors known as the Saiyans. Shortly after being born, he narrowly escaped the extinction of his entire race by the tyrannical Frieza as an infant when he was sent from a space pod to Earth with the mission to wipe out the inhabitants and conquer the planet. A kind old man named Gohan soon found him and took in the young Kakarot, renaming him as "Son Goku". He was quite a vicious child until he hit his head after falling in a ravine, giving him amnesia and erasing his natural-born Saiyan bloodlust. As Goku grew, he also developed a love for fighting and adventure, traveling the world in frequent search of the legendary wish-granting Dragon Balls, as well as to train and fight against strong opponents. Trained by legendary masters and god-like beings, Goku became Earth's protector against all that come its way, be it aliens, androids, mystical entities, gods, or even his own race. To this day, he still trains hard and strives to be the greatest warrior possible, while at the same time using his amazing strength and skills to uphold peace.
Kaio-ken: With this powerup, Goku is surrounded by a red aura. Its maximum multiplier is shown to be x20.
Super Saiyan: Goku first achieves this form in a rage after Frieza killed Krillin. In this form, Goku's muscle and height slight increase and his skin turns lighter. His eyes become noticeably sterner and more defined with green eyes. His hair becomes blond and stands with no loose strands. His power also generates a yellow aura. In the anime, when unleashing the full intensity of his power, Goku's aura also produces some slight electrical sparks. Goku's demeanor is greatly affected by this form, making him more aggressive and irritable.
Super Saiyan 2: Goku achieved this form at some time after Cell's defeat while in the Other World. In this form, Goku gains some changes; his hair becomes spikier, his forehead has only three bangs over it, making his hair more defined than his other previous Super Saiyan forms. His muscles also become more defined, and his aura also generates electricity surrounding his body, while the aura itself grows markedly larger and more vibrant. Since gaining greater forms, Goku reserves this form for opponents he takes semi-seriously.
Super Saiyan 3: Goku achieved this level after years of training in Other World, where he could put unlimited energy into this form. In this form, his hair reaches down to his thighs and his eyebrows vanish completely while making the forehead and eye ridges larger and more prominent. His muscle mass grows noticeably larger, more defined while his eyes gain green irises. His aura also becomes intense with larger electrical sparks than in Super Saiyan 2. Goku first used this state against Innocent Buu during the Majin Buu Saga, where he had a slight advantage over the Majin. However, Super Saiyan 3 is extremely draining in terms of energy use due to the living world having less energy to siphon. This makes him tired quickly and at one point even cut Goku's afterlife time left on Earth from hours to a mere thirty minutes after using this form for a short time. When attempting to gather enough energy to defeat Kid Buu, he was unable to sustain it as he had not taken into account the strain overcoming his living body and soon reverted to his base form. Altogether, these heavy disadvantages make it impractical to use this form out of the afterlife and even more so while alive in long battles.
Super Saiyan God: Goku achieves this legendary form during the God of Destruction Beerus Saga with the help of five other pure-hearted Saiyans, using it in a final stand against God of Destruction Beerus and managing to make the latter fight seriously. Goku's appearance in this form is mostly the same as his base form but with a bright red aura and hair, red irises, slightly thinner and more youthful, and a darker skin tone. His aura generates like an orange flame.
As a Super Saiyan God, Goku achieves a whole new realm of power, well beyond Super Saiyan 3. The form transforms Goku into a divine being, granting unbelievable strength while only requiring the most minute number of stamina to maintain the transformation. Additionally, Goku is able to fight with more finesse and grace as he instinctively predicts his opponent's attacks with more efficiency.
Super Saiyan Blue: After training with Whis, Goku learned to synchronize Super Saiyan with Super Saiyan God, causing him to become a Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan, more commonly known as Super Saiyan Blue. This form is identical to Super Saiyan in appearance, only with cyanish-blue hair and eyes with a blue aura shaded by some gold. The form's power is a level that surpasses Super Saiyan God and offers increased levels of ki and emotional control. Goku learns to enhance this form's power further through different means, including using the Kaio-ken while in this form, and intense rage.
Perfected Ultra Instinct: Once understanding Whis' words behind self-movement, Goku learned to let go of all self-doubt and live in the moment. When fully synchronizing his impulses with his natural drive, Goku can subconsciously unlock the full potential of his offensive and defensive might. This culminates with Goku's silver glow consuming him, turning his hair silver and skin tone more ethereal in nature. The power in this form is vastly greater than his Sign state that it completely shreds away his shirt upon transforming (in the anime). In this state, Goku showed such excellent control of his ki, able to calmly repel and contain any energy assault thrown at him. He can unleash barrages of his energy in focused shockwaves and cancel out all but the strongest of attacks. In addition, while accessing this state, Goku's body is fully rejuvenated.
